pins.move: grep -rlE 'companygraph/mcp-server[^[:space:]"]*(#|@|\?ref=)v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' package.json .github/workflows infra | xargs perl -pi -e 's~(companygraph/mcp-server[^\s"]*?(?:#|@|\?ref=))v\d+\.\d+\.\d+~${1}{version}~g' && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json'));const suffix='node_modules/companygraph-meta-model';for(const k of Object.keys(l.packages)){if(k===suffix||k.endsWith('/'+suffix)){delete l.packages[k];fs.rmSync(k,{recursive:true,force:true})}}fs.writeFileSync('package-lock.json',JSON.stringify(l,null,2)+'\n')" && npm install

verify: GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)} npm run snapshot
